# Gara de Nord

> Gara de Nord is Chisinau's primary North Bus Station providing real-time schedules, ticket information, and travel services across Moldova and regional routes.

Gara de Nord Chisinau serves as a major transportation hub in Moldova offering comprehensive bus scheduling, booking information, and customer support across Romanian, Russian, and English language interfaces. The site also hosts miscellaneous technical and lifestyle content.
